versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11009, SRS_Os_11013 If interrupts are disabled/suspended by a Task / ISR /Hook and the Task / ISR /Hook calls any Operating System service (excluding the interrupt services) then the Operat- ing System module shall ignore the service AND shall return E_OS_DISABLEDINT if the service returns a StatusType value.

If interrupts are disabled/suspended by a Task / ISR /Hook and the Task / ISR /Hook calls any Operating System service (excluding the interrupt ser- vices) then the Operating System module shall ignore the service AND shall return E_OS_DISABLEDINT if the service returns a StatusType value.
